doc: Gated (B). Under the Balanced preset a partner agent's evaluate in the user's live session asks first (debug.live-eval: a card, the call refused until the user answers), its read of the sessions is allowed (none run here), its hypothesis is a debug_hypothesis record of its session with the debug-investigation event, and a step asks (debug.drive). The project has a launch configuration, so the session has the debugger tools. Pattern B: each call's turn, idle with an agent entry, gates the reads.

args: for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: debug.live-eval needs the user.s yes' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1

sql: select count(*) from card where kind = 'matrix' and state = 'open' and title like 'debug.live-eval%'

args: for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: {.*sessions.*\[\]' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1
for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: {.*hypothesis' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1

sql: select count(*) from entity where kind = 'debug_hypothesis' and status = 'open' and json_extract(data, '$.agent') = '$a'

args: for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: debug.drive needs the user.s yes' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1
